1080	Rabbi Shlomo Kluger says: a man who has sons who continue his path is called
1081	"omed" (standing).
1082	A man who has no sons is called "holech" (going).
1083	Even though we all know that angels are called "omdim" (standing).
1084	While a man is called "holech" (going), right?
1085	"And I will give you paths to walk."
1086	"Mehalchim" (those who walk).
1087	So "you" are called "walkers."
1088	Man is called "holech," because man goes to his eternal home, and an angel is called "omed."
1089	Rabbi Shlomo Kluger says, my friends, I want to tell you, learn a rule.
1090	A man who has sons is called "omed," a man who has no sons is called "holech," as it says: "Weep
1091	weep for the one who goes."
1092	Who is "weep, weep for the one who goes"?
1093	For one who goes from this world without sons.
1094	If he has no sons, then that's it, he has no name.
1095	How do you call him?
1096	"Yaamod"?
1097	There is no "yaamod."
1098	If he had a son, they say, "Yaamod David son of Moshe."
1099	So his father is Moshe, and the son is David.
1100	So everything is fine.
1101	You mention his father.
1102	You say, do you know who he is?
1103	Wow, his son is David.
1104	Do you know who he is?
1105	The son of Rav Dubi, do you know who he is?
1106	You keep mentioning the father all the time.
1107	Not only at the Torah reading, he says, you see him?
1108	He is the son of the Rav HaGoel.
1109	You keep praising the father all the time.
1110	So what is that called?
1111	The father hasn't been here for fifty years, but still he stands.
1112	His name stands and endures.
1113	When his children get aliyot, when you mention him, so what is he called?
1114	He is called "omed."
1115	Once a man dies without sons, says Rabbi Shlomo Kluger, what does he become?
1116	"Holech" — his name went, and his name is no longer mentioned.
1117	Unless...
1118	The man left behind what?
1119	He left behind eternal works, the Chazon Ish, who died without sons.
